name: 绿翼鸟
evolution: 绿翼鸟 → 魔翼鸟 Lv.20 → 魔眷鸟 Lv.32
evolutionEn: L Yiniao → Moyiniao Lv.20 → Mojuanniao Lv.32
description: 胆小谨慎的精灵，总是下意识地遮挡和隐藏自己。头部心型冠的原理不明，要小心对待，拉扯后，绿翼鸟的性格和样貌会大变，拉扯三次后变回本来的性格和样貌。
descriptionEn: A timid and cautious spirit, always instinctively shielding and hiding itself. The principle of its heart-shaped crest is unknown; treat it carefully—after pulling, its personality and appearance change drastically, and after pulling three times it returns to its original self.

skills.name: 甜心续航
skills.description: 自己和敌方获得萌化：回复40%生命。
skills.descriptionEn: Self and enemy gain Cutify: recover 40% HP.

skills.name: 超级糖果
skills.description: 造成物伤，自己获得萌化：本次技能威力+60。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; gains Cutify: this skill's power +60.

skills.name: 防御
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage by 70%, when responding to attacks.

skills.name: 羽化加速
skills.description: 自己获得全技能威力+20，迅捷。

skills.name: 砂糖弹球
skills.description: 造成物伤，双方体重差越大，本次技能威力越高。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; greater weight difference between sides increases this skill's power.

skills.name: 生日蛋糕
skills.description: 驱散自己的减益，自己的增益翻倍。
skills.descriptionEn: Dispels own debuffs; doubles own buffs.

skills.name: 疾风刺
skills.description: 造成物伤，1连击，若先于敌方攻击，改为3连击。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage, 1-hit combo; if acting before the enemy, becomes 3-hit combo.

skills.name: 扇风
skills.description: 造成物伤，若先于敌方攻击，本次技能威力+50%。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; if acting before the enemy, this skill's power +50%.

skills.name: 逆袭
skills.description: 造成物伤，本技能能耗每+1，威力+50。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; for each +1 energy cost, power +50.

skills.name: 月光合奏
skills.description: 造成物伤，1连击，双方携带的所有精灵每有1层萌化，本次技能连击数+1。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage, 1-hit combo; for each layer of Cutify on all owned spirits, this skill's combo +1.

skills.name: 龙卷风
skills.description: 造成物伤，迅捷，应对状态：本次技能威力变为1.5倍。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage, with Swift; when responding to status: this skill's power becomes 1.5x.
